title: Chat with Looker Studio Pro Reports
text:
Querying Looker Studio reports usually requires manual navigation, slowing down data access. I have built AI chatbots that process natural language queries and retrieve specific data points efficiently. I developed a retrieval-augmented support assistant that chunked documents and embedded them into a vector index, improving search efficiency (portfolio case study: Retrieval-augmented support assistant) I also created a menu-aware chatbot that confirms items and handles user interactions smoothly (portfolio case study: WhatsApp order-taking chatbot). My background includes NLP and LLM applications, which are essential for building a robust AI Chatbot.

I would approach this by integrating the chat interface with Looker Studio APIs to fetch report data. The system would parse user questions, query the relevant data, and return concise answers. This ensures the Chatbot Development is both accurate and user-friendly. I will focus on a simple, direct interface that allows you to query your reports without complex setup.

What specific types of questions do you expect users to ask most frequently?

Real-time gait recognition
text: Real-time gait recognition across multiple cameras requires a model that balances inference speed with identification accuracy. I have built computer vision systems using Python and PyTorch, such as a fabric defect detector that processed 6,400 frames on edge hardware (portfolio repository: loom-inspect README). I also developed an invoice extraction pipeline using OpenCV and Python to handle complex visual data (portfolio repository: invoice-reader README). My background in machine learning allows me to approach gait recognition by training a robust model and optimizing it for NVIDIA Deep Stream deployment. I can provide a demo version to validate accuracy before full multi-camera integration. What is the target frame rate for your multi-camera setup?

title: Real Estate Financial Analysis
text:
Your real estate investment requires a precise Excel model to evaluate two distinct financing sources, including an interest-only loan with a balloon payment. I have built financial models and cash-flow forecasts that support investment decisions, such as a three-statement model with scenario switches for a startup (portfolio case study: Financial model and cash-flow forecast). This work was used in a successful pre-seed raise, demonstrating the reliability of the projections (portfolio client review: Review by operations manager, Indus Startup Co.).

I specialize in Financial Modeling and Financial Analysis using Microsoft Excel. I have experience creating complex Excel-based tools, including inventory demand forecasts that feed reorder points back into Excel sheets (portfolio repository: stock-forecast README). My approach involves structuring inputs for both financing sources clearly, ensuring that ROI, cash-on-cash return, payback period, cap rate, IRR, monthly cash flow, and debt service coverage ratio are calculated accurately and dynamically.

I will build a clean, documented model that allows you to adjust assumptions easily. How many months of historical data do you have for the property’s operating expenses?
